title: LyricsDraft
description: Your reply to the songwriter and up to five lyric suggestions.

reply.description: A short, friendly reply in plain text.

suggestions.description: Up to five concrete lyric suggestions the songwriter can apply; empty when the reply alone is enough.

label.description: A short title for the suggestion, at most 80 characters.

text.description: The lyric text to add or substitute, at most 2000 characters, without section headings.

action.description: insert adds the text at the cursor; replace_selection replaces the selected lyrics; replace_section replaces the body of one song section.

section_id.description: The id of the section to replace; null unless the action is replace_section.
